warranty.notes: 60% of capacity at 15 years or 28.84 MWh life cycle discharge per 7 kWh battery pack, whichever comes first. The power module (IS-BATT-7000-BMS) has its own time-only warranty. Requires a connection to the iStore monitoring platform and installation within 31 days of purchase.
